name: 49024 · Portage, MI
findings: ZIP 49024 (Portage) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49024 (Portage) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49024 (Portage) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
